build_bart_model: build a BARTModel instance with an encoder and decoder for sequence-to-sequence tasks
run_bart_forward: run the BARTModel forward pass with src_tokens and prev_output_tokens to generate output
load_bart_pretrained: load a pretrained BART model using from_pretrained with a model name or checkpoint path
register_bart_classification_head: register a classification head on the BART model for sentence-level classification tasks
configure_bart_architecture: configure the bart_large or bart_base architecture by setting encoder and decoder hyperparameters
